name: Network Security
description: Skills related to the security assessment and exploitation of network infrastructure, services, and protocols. Covers the full lifecycle from reconnaissance through post-exploitation, as well as network architecture and infrastructure security assessment.

categories.name: Reconnaissance
categories.description: Active and passive network reconnaissance techniques. Covers host discovery, port scanning, service identification, network mapping, and fingerprinting.

categories.name: Enumeration
categories.description: In-depth enumeration of network services, users, shares, and configurations. Covers protocol-specific enumeration (SMB, LDAP, DNS, SNMP, etc.) and information gathering from exposed services.

categories.name: Exploitation
categories.description: Exploitation of network services and protocols. Covers vulnerability identification, exploit selection and modification, service-level attacks, and authentication attacks.

categories.name: Post-Exploitation
categories.description: Activities following initial access. Covers privilege escalation, credential harvesting, persistence mechanisms, lateral movement preparation, and data exfiltration techniques.

categories.name: Pivoting
categories.description: Network pivoting and tunneling techniques. Covers port forwarding, proxy chains, VPN tunneling, and multi-hop access to segmented networks.

categories.name: Network Infrastructure
categories.description: Assessment of network infrastructure components. Covers routers, switches, firewalls, VPN concentrators, network segmentation, and ICS/SCADA/OT network security.
